accountCoverage: Existing vault binding leaves encrypted ledger and cloud revision intact
Fresh-device username/password login decrypts original key and restores records without duplicate books
Wrong and unknown logins return generic failure and preserve data
Password update invalidates old password while existing key-connected devices continue syncing
Recovery key resets password without requiring remembered username
One account per vault and one vault per username, no rename
Stale password update is rejected using revision compare-and-swap
Encrypted-key metadata tampering fails authenticated decryption
Successful bind can be read after a lost network response
Missing migration or auth limiter disables account API without blocking original vault API
Cross-origin, unauthorized, malformed and oversized requests rejected
Previously associated device cannot silently change space through login or recovery
320 CSS-pixel account dialog has no horizontal overflow
Account and vault API responses excluded from service-worker cache
